description: TfL publishes the polygon boundary of the Ultra Low Emission Zone expansion introduced in August 2023. The source says it follows deposited plans signed off by the London Mayor. The layer delineates the policy area and does not provide vehicle emissions, charge payments, exemptions or observed traffic changes. It can delimit transport policy scenarios alongside independently sourced network, fleet and demand inputs. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
